explication: CouchDB is a JSON document database exposed over HTTP; its README emphasizes running a clustered server, but does not document the request-to-storage workflow. The tree and sampled sources show Nouveau, an auxiliary Lucene indexing service, plus several JavaScript query-server runtimes. The graph captures those visible subsystems and avoids asserting how unsampled CouchDB modules connect them. Nouveau call relationships are supported by the SOURCE INDEX; HTTP routing and the wider CouchDB integration were not sampled.
